findings: Explicit tornado or waterspout text can win before supercell in the current primary normalizer.
Supercell text currently wins before downburst, severe_thunderstorm and hail.
The current normalizer also maps mesocyclone/mesozyklone text directly to primary hazard_type supercell.
Whether mesocyclone is sufficient evidence for supercell is a semantic question for P3-SUPERCELL-20, not an inventory decision.

weather.convection.thunderstorm_cells.reason_not_supercell_contract: A detected/nowcast convective cell is not a supercell classification.

weather.point.thunder_probability.reason_not_supercell_contract: Thunderstorm probability is not supercell probability or supercell observation.

hard_boundaries: A thunderstorm cell is not automatically a supercell.
Thunderstorm probability is not supercell probability.
Tornado is not automatically proof of a supercell.
Hail is not automatically proof of a supercell.
Downburst is not automatically proof of a supercell.
Lightning is not automatically proof of a supercell.
Radar rotation or mesocyclone evidence is not automatically a confirmed supercell.
Registry topic membership is not proof of an active supercell event.
Endpoint reachability is not coverage proof.
open_semantic_questions: Define the exact official-supercell alert/event class, if one is justified.
Decide whether mesocyclone/mesozyklone text is sufficient for supercell semantics or must remain a separate rotation-signature class.
Separate explicit event/headline evidence from contextual description/instruction evidence.
Decide how supercell semantics coexist with tornado, hail, downburst and severe_thunderstorm when primary hazard_type remains single-label.
Decide whether alert_stage is reused for official supercell alert semantics.
Keep radar/rotation evidence separate from confirmed/observed supercell semantics.
Keep thunderstorm-cell nowcast and thunder-probability contracts outside supercell event semantics.
invariants: Future/planned providers do not count as current coverage.
Provider ID is not a scoring axis.
P3-SUPERCELL-10 does not change runtime normalization ordering.
P3-SUPERCELL-10 makes no decision that mesocyclone is sufficient supercell evidence.
Thunderstorm-cell and thunder-probability contracts remain semantically unchanged.
